title: Cone decay at a tangent point (n ≥ 1): the mass near x in a cone around T^⊥ is o(t^n)
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, U ⊆ ℝ^N, V an n-varifold on U, x ∈ ℝ^N, T ∈ G(N,n) and θ ∈ ℝ with HasTangentPlane V x T θ, and let β > 0; write p_T := Grassmannian.project T. Then for every ε ∈ (0,∞] there is δ > 0 such that for all t ∈ (0,δ): μ_V({y ∈ B_t(x) : β|y − x| ≤ |(y − x) − p_T(y − x)|}) ≤ ε t^n (B_t(x) = closedBall x t).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), 0 < n → HasTangentPlane V x T θ → ∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), V.weight {y | y ∈ closedBall x t ∧ β * ‖y - x‖ ≤ ‖(y - x) - Grassmannian.project T (y - x)‖} ≤ ε * ENNReal.ofReal t ^ n
